name: nodeui-monorepo
description: NodeUI — a BootUI-inspired, local-only developer console for Express and NestJS applications.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @singhak/nodeui-core && npm run build -w @singhak/nodeui-express && npm run build -w @singhak/nodeui-nestjs && npm run build -w @singhak/nodeui-ui
scripts.test: npm run test -w @singhak/nodeui-core && npm run test -w @singhak/nodeui-express && npm run test -w @singhak/nodeui-nestjs && npm run test -w @singhak/nodeui-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @singhak/nodeui-core && npm run typecheck -w @singhak/nodeui-express && npm run typecheck -w @singhak/nodeui-nestjs && npm run typecheck -w @singhak/nodeui-ui && npm run typecheck -w @singhak/nodeui-demo-express && npm run typecheck -w @singhak/nodeui-demo-nestjs
